$description: Leaf Digital brand tokens, mined from archive-site-v1-static/index.html (the live v1 site). Canonical source for the Tailwind v4 theme. Values are exact copies of the live CSS unless noted.

logo.note: The mark + wordmark green (favicon.svg, nav logo). Deep forest. Used ONLY for the logo on v1; proposed as brand-900-adjacent anchor.

green.note: 50-200 are Tailwind-green tints (backgrounds/badges); 400-900 are the Material-green ramp. v1 CTA gradient: 135deg green-500 → green-700. Text-on-white uses green-700+ (green-500 fails 4.5:1 contrast on white — body-text use is banned).

neutral.note: Tailwind gray scale, verbatim from v1. Body text gray-800 on white; secondary gray-500.

family.proposed: Geist Sans via next/font — cleaner, self-hostable, zero external request; Poppins kept as the continuity option if the maintainer prefers exact v1 look
